prs.title: perf(nuxt): read render-list imports without building AST
prs.author: onmax
prs.body: ### 🔗 Linked issue No issue. ### 📚 Description `nuxt:render-list` calls `parseModule(code, id).program.body` on every server module that contains `renderList` or `ssrRenderList`, and then reads only the import declarations. Reading `program` makes rolldown/utils `JSON.parse` the whole AST into JS objects. This PR reads `parseModule(code, id).module.staticImports` instead, the same change #36784 makes in `ssr-styles`. Each entry there has the source, the statement span, the imported and local names, and `isType`. `program` is a lazy getter, so the plugin builds the AST only when a declaration has an inline `type` specifier. An entry's span starts at its name, so it doesn't cover the `type` keyword. `import type` declarations are still skipped. The new test covers an inline `type` specifier and a string import name. I also ran the old and the new transform on all 5,318 compiled scripts of the app below, and each one gave the same output. The plugin only runs in the server build. On a generated app with 12 layers and 2,860 components, on Nuxt 5 nightly, three runs each: | | before | after | | --- | --- | --- | | hook time, server, 1,394 calls | 918 to 977 ms | 412 to 439 ms | These are Rolldown's per-plugin timings. Total build time stayed within the noise of a shared machine. The build output is identical, 8,261 of 8,261 files in all three runs.

prs.title: perf(nuxt): defer ssr prefetch hints until the app is ready
prs.author: danielroe
prs.body: ### 🔗 Linked issue ### 📚 Description currently we render prefetch links for every dynamic import into a page. that can add up, particularly for big sites or sites using a ui library. and the problem is that this can compete with critical js or css during hydration this instead tells the browser to prefetch these pages only after the page has been hydrated and is interactive. here's the result for a test I ran (a demo marketing page with about 690 nuxt/ui components) | Lighthouse 13 mobile, simulated | main | branch | | - | - | - | | LCP | 1153ms | 1071ms | | bytes loaded during the trace | 303KB | 288KB |
